notes.title: Complete Graphics Overhaul!
notes.notes:
[p]Commanders,[/p][p]We’re excited to share the news about the latest development in Project AionIX! [/p][p]This update includes a full overhaul of the graphics – every visual asset in the game has been polished. The outcome? A distinct, unified, and more professional appearance that significantly enhances the aesthetic of the cosmic battlefield.[/p][h3]🔹 What’s New:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Complete Artistic Overhaul[/b] – Every Ship, enemy and the surrounding environments now have new artwork.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consistency of Style[/b] – The earlier prototypes have moved a long way and it is much more in line with the refined professional identity deserving of the battles that await.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! With visuals upgraded, we can now focus on refining gameplay and preparing the road ahead toward story content and new modes.[/p][p]Your feedback means the world to us as we collectively shape Project AionIX. We would appreciate it if you could share what you think of the new design on our community hub or in the comments below.[/p][p]See you in the fight,
The AionBlaze Studio Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307693/e4fed809044b3006fabf6380b2bb3390a5e1d271.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A New Challenger Awaits in Project AionIX!
notes.notes:
Suit up, pilots! A major update is here for Project AionIX, and it’s bringing the heat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307693/b48fd5672e3a56edaf4840c103043c7291a479c4.jpg[/img]

[b]New Boss Battle[/b]

Wave 12 just got serious. Survive the onslaught to face off against a brand-new boss encounter. This foe is unforgiving — its attacks evolve as its parts are damaged, and it won’t go down without a fight. Think you can survive its final form?

[b]Boss Challenge Mode[/b]

Want to skip straight to the action? We’ve got you. From the main menu, jump directly into the boss fight with a fully-upgraded loadout. No warm-ups, just pure chaos.

[b]Visual Overhaul[/b]

The player ship has received a sleek visual upgrade. Better art, sharper details, same deadly firepower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307693/bad5f9a7fbcd39b2617323b0e449fd120b189541.jpg[/img]

This is our biggest update yet — and it's just the beginning. Challenge yourself, share your feedback, and stay tuned for more exciting features as we continue building the universe of Project AionIX.

notes.title: The Demo for Project AionIX is Now Live!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that the demo for Project AionIX is now available on Steam!

Dive into two exciting gameplay modes and experience the game firsthand to get a taste of what's to come!

Play both available modes and challenge yourself to top the high scores.

This demo is a great way to explore the game's enemies, mechanics, and help us gather valuable feedback before the full release.

The demo is free to play!
